name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided.

name: Castillero Athletic Booster Club
description: Attention 5th grade parents! Looking to get involved at Castillero? Consider joining the Castillero Athletic Booster Club (CABC) Board! The time commitment is very manageable and it is a great way to get involved at Castillero!

name: Castillero Music Booster Club Fundraiser
description: Support Our CMBC Program – Sweeten Easter & Mother's Day! We've partnered with See's Candies once again to bring you delicious, high-quality chocolates just in time for Easter and Mother's Day. All sales from this storefront will support instruments, sheet music, and performance opportunities for our students—and we'd love your support!

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos
description: 5th grade parents - baby photos are due March 31st! Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: Yearbook Update
description: The draft of the yearbook will be finalized right after the Spring Break. If you are a parent yearbook POC, please finalize your pages by the end of this week! If you haven't purchased the yearbook, please purchase it before April 20th. No yearbooks will be sold once they are distributed.

name: PTA Board Positions for 2026-27
